senses.gloss:
घृत घृ + त (properly ptcple. of the pf. pass. of 1. घृ), n.
 1. Clarified butter, or butter which has been boiled gently and allowed to cool, Man. 11, 134.
 2. (ved.) Rain, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3.
घृतवन्त् घृत + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, [] Abundant in butter, Chr. 290, 6 = Rigv. i. 64, 6.
घृताची घृताची, i. e. घृत-अञ्च् + इ, f. The name of an Apsaras, MBh. 1, 4821.
घृतिन् घृतिन्, i. e. घृत + इन्, adj., f. नी, Containing ghṛta, MBh. 13, 1840.
घृत- + पशु घृत- + पशु, m. the image of a beast formed with clarified butter, Man. 5, 37.
घृत- + पूर घृत- + पूर, [] m. a sweetmeat composed of flour, butter, etc.
